view_frame: The drawing provides a TOP view (XY plane) and a FRONT view (XZ plane). The world origin (0,0,0) is defined at the bottom-left corner of the plate's top face. X extends to the right (width), Y extends upwards (depth), and Z extends downwards (thickness/height).

features.evidence: Top view shows the outline with dimensions 60 and 40. Text notes 'Top-right corner R6 only', 'Notch: 20 wide x 10 deep', 'Notch centred on top edge'. Front view shows '6 thick' and notes 'Same outline through full thickness'.

features.placement: Center at (12, 15). Axis parallel to Z. Extends from Z=0 to Z=6.
features.evidence: Top view shows a circle labeled 'Ø8 THROUGH'. Text notes 'Hole centre: 12 from left edge, 15 from bottom edge'.

connections: The through_hole is subtracted from the plate_body.
The plate_body is the base solid.
edit_rules: Changing plate width (60) moves the right edge and the top-right arc center.
Changing plate depth (40) moves the top edge and the notch floor.
Changing thickness (6) scales the Z extrusion.
Changing notch width (20) adjusts the X coordinates of the notch vertical walls symmetrically around X=30.
Changing notch depth (10) adjusts the Y coordinate of the notch floor.
Changing hole diameter (8) scales the circle radius.
Changing hole position (12, 15) moves the circle center.
